description.es: Jesús intenta convencer a Marta de que reconsidere su propuesta, y la tensión entre ellos aumenta día a día. Jaime le dice a Marta que tiene un tumor cerebral y que va a morir.
description.en: Jesús tries to convince Marta to reconsider his proposal, and the tension between them grows by the day. Jaime tells Marta that he has a brain tumor and that he is going to die.
